rationale: Price has rallied sharply from the open low of $126.90 to $129.00, placing it at 78.9% of today's range and within $0.56 of today's high — the easy momentum move off the open has already occurred. The spread between current price and the 9-EMA ($127.10) is wide, suggesting an extended short-term condition where chasing long carries poor risk/reward, while shorting near today's high with a gap-down open and positive SPY/falling VIXY backdrop is equally unattractive. With two working orders already consuming 6% of buying power, adding a third position in a name showing indecision on the last two candles (wicks, lower closes) is not warranted.
